run_binary_size_diff: run the binary size diff script to compare gRPC Objective-C sample binary sizes against a git commit or branch
build_grpc_ios_sample: build the gRPC Objective-C sample project with or without frameworks using the build function
get_size_binary_components: get the binary sizes for Core, ObjC, BoringSSL, Protobuf, and Total from a gRPC iOS build directory
dir_size_calculate_total: calculate the total size of all files recursively within a given directory path
review_binary_size_report: review the Objective-C binary size report comparing new and old build sizes with diff thresholds
